claims.evidence: Witness only reports a wooden slatted pallet with cut-out openings and wear; no markings or dimensions are shown to confirm it is 'standard' (e.g., 4-way entry, specific size/type).

risks.risk: Unknown pallet type/entry style and dimensions (could be non-standard size or not 4-way entry), affecting buyer fit and handling cost.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the full pallet dimensions (L/W/H) and the underside entry points (all sides) to confirm 4-way vs 2-way entry.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used wooden pallets with uncertain compatibility.

risks.risk: Condition issues not fully visible: missing slats, broken boards, loose nails/screws, cracks, or structural weakness.
risks.proof: A close-up video/pan across the top deck and underside showing every slat and stringer, plus a shake test clip showing no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used pallets with possible minor damage (not guaranteed load-bearing).

risks.risk: Treatment/infestation compliance unknown (HT vs MB, fumigation status), which matters for export and sometimes for strict buyers.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the stamp/marking on the pallet (e.g., IPPC logo with HT/MB) and any treatment labels.

risks.risk: Quantity ambiguity: photos show both a single pallet and stacked pallets; seller may be selling multiple units or only one.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full stack count (top view and side view) with a visible count or a tape measure reference.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming the worst-case for the buyer: fewer usable pallets than expected.

risks.risk: Load capacity/usage history unknown (could have carried heavy/chemical loads or be warped).
risks.proof: A clip showing pallet flatness (straightedge/level check) and underside condition, plus any odor/staining evidence close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used pallets with unknown prior load and potential wear/warp.

proof_requests: Provide exact pallet dimensions (L/W/H) and confirm entry style (4-way or 2-way) with photos of all sides and underside.
Show close-ups of the entire deck and underside to confirm no missing/broken slats and no loose nails/screws (include a short shake test video).
Capture a clear photo of any treatment stamp/marking (IPPC/HT/MB) on the pallet.
Confirm quantity being sold (how many pallets) with a photo that clearly shows the full stack count.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as wooden slatted storage pallets, so a worst-case used generic pallet valuation is possible; however, key details (size/type, treatment, exact quantity, structural integrity) are not fully verifiable from the report.
